purpose: Move from human review labels toward deterministic autonomous-trading gates by converting fractional-share, short-stock, short-availability, cash-buffer, and capacity checks into machine-enforced rules.

ibkr_short_availability.source: IBKR TWS API reqMktData generic tick 236

interpretation.status: Short-stock review is now machine-gated instead of manually blocked when IBKR short availability data is present.
interpretation.finding: Fractional shares and short stock can pass the autonomous gate when explicitly allowed and backed by IBKR short availability. The remaining block is only the configured max_auto_orders capacity cap.
interpretation.recommendation: Next milestone should build a paper execution intent ledger and kill-switch controlled order router. Live transmit should remain disabled until broker what-if/margin, duplicate-order, open-order, and position-conflict gates are all mandatory.
